rows.text: You once again return to the repairman's workshop. As if he had a premonition of your arrival, he lays out a pile of parts neatly on the table as he excitedly hums a little tune.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "There's nothing in this world that has no value. There are only things with value that have not been discovered yet."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Military titles, weapons, funds, and research labs... Do so-called 'things of value' still have value when they take away joy? It took me many years to understand this."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Do you remember the scraps you left behind? I made them into new toys. Why don't you have a go? I believe you can do it." The old man pushes the parts to you with an expectant look in his eyes.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Let waste be reborn as smiles.
The discarded parts are combined into misshapen toys, yet you feel a smile controllably creeping up on the ends of your lips.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
